Arroz con Pollo (ACP) 🧀🍗 This is easily one of our FAVORITE family dinners. It’s the version of arroz con pollo I always ordered at Mexican restaurants when I lived in Virginia: Mexican rice, seasoned chicken, and an absolutely unreasonable amount of queso. 😂 I couldn’t find it prepared this way after moving to Washington, so eventually I learned to make it myself. Now it’s on our table at least once a month! For the rice: • 1 batch Mexican restaurant-style rice 👉 I use the recipe from @jessvesco. I tried SO many recipes before finding this one, and her method works perfectly for me every single time! For the chicken: • 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, thinly sliced • 2 Tbsp oil • 2 Tbsp water • 1 batch homemade fajita seasoning Fajita seasoning: • ½ Tbsp chili powder • ½ Tbsp ground cumin • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • ½ tsp dried oregano • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp ground black pepper For the queso: • 1½ lbs white American cheese, from the deli counter • 8 oz pepper jack cheese • 2 cups milk Directions: Prepare your Mexican rice according to your favorite recipe. Toss the sliced chicken thighs with the oil, water and fajita seasoning. Cook the chicken in batches over high heat until cooked through with plenty of browned, slightly crispy edges. Avoid overcrowding the pan so the chicken sears instead of steaming. For the queso, combine the white American cheese, pepper jack and milk over low heat. Stir frequently and melt everything together slowly until completely smooth and creamy. No roux needed! To serve, start with a generous bed of Mexican rice, pile on the chicken, and smother the entire situation in queso. This one takes a little more time (and a LOT more cheese) than most of my weeknight dinners, but it’s still cheaper than taking a family of four out to eat. And there are NEVER complaints when ACP is for dinner. 😂 #ArrozConPollo #ACP #ChickenAndRice #MexicanRestaurantStyle #FamilyDinner #DinnerIdeas #RealisticDinners #ChickenRecipes #ComfortFood #WhatsForDinner

Apple Pie Cinnamon Rolls 🍎💛🥰 the most moist and tender apple pie cinnamon rolls! Now that apple picking is coming up soon, this recipe is perfect to ring in the fall season!  Makes 9 rolls. Ingredients For the Dough: * 180g milk whole is best * 1 1/8 teaspoons (6 grams) active dry yeast  * 1 teaspoon honey * 1 large egg plus 1 large egg yolk, room temperature * 75g sugar * ½ teaspoon salt * 410g bread flour plus extra for rolling * 60g butter room temperature  For the Cinnamon Sugar Filling: * 64g Unsalted butter, softened * 95g Brown sugar * 2 tsp Ground cinnamon * 1/8 tsp Ground nutmeg For the Apple Pie Filling/Topping (Use only 350-400g for the filling, the remaining filling is for the topping after the rolls are baked): * 650g apples (about 3-4 apples), peel cored and small diced * 3 tbsp butter  * Juice of 1 lemon  * 110g brown sugar, packed  * 1/4 tsp salt * 2 teaspoon cinnamon * Cornstarch slurry: 2 1/2 tsp cornstarch plus 2 1/2 tsp water Classic cream cheese icing: * 56g unsalted butter, room temperature  * 4 oz cream cheese, room temperature * 1/2 tsp cinnamon  * 2-3 tbsp heavy cream or milk * 100g icing sugar  After the rolls have proofed, pour about 1/4 cup heavy cream over the rolls and bake at 350 for 27-30 minutes. Or until the cinnamon rolls have fully baked.  Full detailed recipe also posted on my website. Gas ⛽️ or Trash 🗑️? Creamy Boursin Orzo Chicken Bake Click the link in my bio for a special offer and download the @ReciMe | Save recipes app to save of my recipes in one easy-to-find place! Macros (Per Serving - Makes 4) Calories — 492 Protein — 41g Carbs — 48g Fat — 17g Ingredients 🥣 12 oz or 340g cooked chicken breast, diced  6 oz or 180g dry orzo (cooked with chicken stock) 3 cups or 650g cherry tomatoes 2 Medium or 300g zucchini, chopped 5.3 oz or 150g Boursin Garlic & Fine Herbs cheese 2 oz or 56g grated Parmesan cheese Avacado/Olive Oil Spray Fresh basil Seasonings to Taste  chili flakes oregano black pepper salt How to make: 🧑‍🍳 1️⃣ Place the Boursin in the center of a baking dish, then add the cherry tomatoes and chopped zucchini around it. Season with chili flakes, oregano, salt and pepper, then lightly spray everything with oil. 2️⃣ Bake at 350°F (180°C) for about 35 minutes, until the tomatoes have softened and the Boursin is hot and creamy. 3️⃣ While that’s baking, cook the orzo according to the package instructions until al dente, then drain. 4️⃣ Remove the baking dish from the oven and mix everything together until the Boursin, tomatoes and zucchini create a creamy sauce. 5️⃣ Add the cooked orzo, chicken and fresh basil, then mix until everything is completely coated. 6️⃣ Top with grated Parmesan and place it back in the oven at 350°F (180°C) for another 5–10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted. 7️⃣ Let it cool for a few minutes, divide into 4 servings and enjoy! My viral recipe: pockets filled with creamy chicken & melty cheese 🧀 Soft dough, juicy chicken… this combo is all time favorite in my home🫶 Save this for later & tell me if you’d try them 👀🔥 INGREDIENTS (for 8 pockets) Chicken filling: – 600 g chicken breast, diced – 20 g butter + 1 tbsp oil – 1 tsp paprika powder – 1 tsp garlic powder – ½ tsp black pepper – Salt to taste – 50 ml water – 100 ml cooking cream/heavy cream  – 1 tbsp honey – 1 tbsp mustard – Chili flakes / chili sauce to taste – 1 tbsp lemon juice – 100 g cheese, grated Dough: – 350 g flour – 50 g cream cheese (with chives & garlic) – 1 tsp salt – 1½ tsp baking powder – 170 ml water Filling: – 8 small Cheddar slices Finish: – Melted butter – Chopped parsley INSTRUCTIONS 1️⃣ Cook the chicken in butter & oil with spices for 4–5 minutes. Add water and let it reduce slightly, then pour in the cooking cream and simmer until creamy and thick. 2️⃣ Add honey and mustard. Finish with lemon juice and chili at the end for freshness and heat. Remove from heat, stir in grated cheese and let the filling cool completely. 3️⃣ Knead all dough ingredients into a soft dough. Cover and rest for 10 minutes. Divide into 8 balls, roll out, place a slice of Cheddar + chicken filling inside, seal well. Heat a skillet with a little oil and fry the rolls for 3–4 minutes on each side until golden. Brush them with a mixture of melted butter and chopped parsley while hot.

Arsenio’s Chicken Alfredo Mac N Cheese 👑🧀🍗 Chicken: 1 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tsp salt Cube your chicken, season it, then cook it halfway on the stove before finishing it in the oven. Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

I’ll also put the recipe below!!🎄🩷  - A note on rise times to ensure maximum fluffiness: make sure to allow the dough to fully proof before baking, especially during the 2nd proof. My house/ environment is very warm so these rise super quickly but if your house is cold right now then you need to create a warmer environment for them to properly rise - you can put them in the oven with the oven light on, or in the microwave after heating up a cup of water for a few minutes, or with a heating pad on low that's wrapped in a towel (we don't want to get the dough hot, just slightly warm). Just make sure they look nice & big & fluffy before baking, & if they're not then let them keep rising. —- Salted Honey Butter Rolls  (with sourdough discard) . Ingredients: Makes 15 extra large rolls or 24 regular sized rolls . For the dough (sourdough version) 690g flour 245g water (warm if your house is cold) 300g sourdough starter or discard 18g yeast 2 large eggs 105g honey (or sugar) 56g salted butter, softened 2.5 tsp salt (12g) . Non-Sourdough Version: If you’re *not* using sourdough discard, increase the flour to 840g total and the water to 395g water total but keep every other measurement the same.  Optional egg wash to brush on top of the rolls: -   1 egg -  about 1 TBSP milk or cream (I found that cream with a splash of water works best) —- Instructions 1. To make the dough: Combine all dough ingredients except for the butter in the bowl of a stand mixer. Mix on low speed for a minute or two until the flour is all absorbed, then mix on high or medium high speed for about 10 minutes until you have a soft, smooth dough that is close to passing the windowpane test. At this point you can add the softened butter and mix for a few more minutes until all combined. The dough should be smooth, strong, and slightly shiny. Shape it into a ball in the mixing bowl and cover. Let rise until it's nearly doubled in size, about 1 to 2 hours.  2. To shape the buns: Gently deflate the dough and divide into 15-24 rolls depending on the size you want. In the video I made 15 extra large rolls that were each about 105 grams. For a more standard size, measure each roll out to about 63g (this will make 24 rolls). Shape each piece into a ball. It will be very sticky but just divide, the plop on a clean surface and start shaping. To smooth it out, cup your hands and pull the dough ball towards you to tighten the outer layer and create a smooth, round dough ball. Place buns on a lightly greased parchment-lined baking sheet. Cover and let rise until light and puffy, about an hour to 1.5 hours (but possibly more, see not above for tips on proof times). Toward the end of the rising time, preheat the oven to 375°F. 3. Make the egg wash: This is optional, but for that extra golden shine on top of your buns, make an egg wash by mixing one egg with a splash of milk or cream. I actually prefer to do a splash of cream with a small splash of water. Mix until you have one cohesive liquid, then brush over the buns before baking. Now sprinkle with coarse sea salt if you'd like (highly recommend). 4. To bake the buns: If you the buns are small, bake for about 16-18 minutes, until golden. For large buns around 100g, you'll need to bake a little bit longer, for about 25 minutes, or until the middle of a roll reads 190F on a thermometer. If you make the XL ones you can take the out when a roll in the center of the pan is getting close to 185F since it will continue to cook a little bit once you take it out. If your rolls are getting too dark, you can turn down the oven temp a little bit during the last 10 minutes. Optional: once they're out of the oven, brush with melted butter or just rub a cold stick of butter over the top of the rolls and it will melt onto them. This will give them a satiny, buttery crust. Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

This is dinner on easy mode! 🍲 Stick of Butter Chicken and Rice will be your best friend in the kitchen when you don't feel like spending hours over the stovetop! Continue reading or click the link in the @allrecipes bio for the full recipe. 🔗 Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Stir rice, French onion soup, beef consomme, and portobello mushrooms together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3/4 cup of the cheese and add butter pieces on top. Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Dave’s Hot Chicken, But Crispier 🔥🍗 3 chicken breasts 1 tsp salt 1 tsp pepper 1 tsp chilli flakes 1 tsp cayenne 1/4 cup milk, buttermilk, or cream 1/4 cup pickle juice 1/2 cup all-purpose flour 2 eggs Corn flakes, don’t crush them Spicy Oil 1/2 cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp cayenne 1 tbsp paprika 1 tbsp brown sugar Dry Rub 1 tbsp cayenne 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp chilli powder Season the chicken breasts with salt, pepper, chilli flakes, and cayenne. Add the milk and pickle juice, then let it marinate. Coat the chicken in flour, dip it into the beaten eggs, then press it into the corn flakes, making sure they stay nice and chunky for that extra crunch. Fry at 350°F (175°C) until golden, crispy, and the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) internally. Mix the cayenne, paprika, and brown sugar into the hot frying oil, then toss the fried chicken straight into the spicy oil until fully coated. Finish with a generous sprinkle of the dry rub and serve immediately while it’s crackling hot. 🔥🍗

GROUND BEEF BULGOGI A quick, savory Korean‑inspired beef bowl that’s perfect for weeknights. INGREDIENTS Main 1 lb ground beef 1 onion, sliced 1 tbsp minced garlic Oil, for cooking Sesame oil, for finishing Sesame seeds, garnish Chopped scallion, garnish Kimchi or radish kimchi, for serving Sauce 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp mirin 4 tbsp soy sauce (low sodium preferred) 1 tbsp Korean plum syrup* *Sub: 1 tbsp water + 1 tsp apple cider vinegar INSTRUCTIONS 1. Peel and slice the onion; set aside. 2. Combine brown sugar, mirin, soy sauce, and plum syrup (or substitute). Mix well and set aside. 3. Heat a little oil in a pan. Add sliced onions and cook for 1 minute. Add minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Add ground beef and break it into small pieces. Once the beef is about 30% cooked, pour in the sauce. Let it simmer until the sauce reduces and evaporates — stir occasionally. (This part takes a little time, but it’s worth it.) 5. Drizzle with sesame oil and give it a final mix. 6. Assemble your bowl with rice, scallions, sesame seeds, and kimchi/ veggie of choice. Enjoy!

12/10 on flavor for this one. 🔥 @NicoleMcLaughlin is back with your easy dinner this week: Mississippi Chicken Casserole. It’s cheesy and creamy, and has that punch of flavor from the pepperoncini peppers that really takes it to the next level. Get the recipe below or tap the link in @allrecipes bio to try it for yourself! 🍽️ Ingredients:  4 ounces cream cheese, softened 1/2 cup sour cream 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese, divided 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted 1/4 cup brine from pepperoncini peppers 1 (1-ounce) package ranch dressing mix 1 (1-ounce) package au jus gravy mix 1 cup milk 3 cups wide egg noodles (6 ounces), cooked according to package directions 3 cups shredded cooked chicken 1 cup sliced pepperoncini peppers Directions:  Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Stir together cream cheese, sour cream, 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, melted butter, pepperoncini brine, ranch dressing mix, and au jus gravy mix in a large bowl until well combined. Stir in milk. Fold in cooked noodles, chicken, and pepperoncini peppers until evenly coated. Spread mixture into the prepared baking dish; sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese. Bake until hot and bubbly, 25 to 30 minutes 🎥: Nicole #mississippichickencasserole #chickencasserole #dinnerideas

✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #DinnerAtRileys #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

High Protein Honey Garlic Butter Chicken Mac n Cheese! Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

Puerto Rican pollo guisado 🇵🇷🥘🍗🌿 Dinner ready in 30 minutes ⏲️  Chicken marinade  Drums (3x) and thighs (4x) 1 tbsp complete seasoning with adobo  1 tbsp of garlic powder  1 tsp of oregano and cumin 1/2 tsp salt 2 tbsp of sofrito  1 sazon packet  Drizzle of olive oil  Marinate for 30 mins to an hour  Pollo guisado  Half an onion  Half a green and red bell pepper  3 garlic cloves  Half can of tomato sauce  2 bay leaves  1/2 tsp adobo  1 packet of sazon 1/2 tsp chicken bouillon  1 tbsp of sofrito  Olives  2 medium sized russet potatoes  Directions  Clean your chicken and add seasonings, sofrio and oil to chicken and let marinate for 30 mins to an hour. Before cooking chicken take out the fridge to allow it to get to room temperature. In a pan add oil and brown chicken on both sides then remove chicken.  Add your onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes before adding garlic.  Add your sofrito, tomatoes sauce, seasonings and olive mixtung together. Allow to simmer until fragrant.  Add your chicken back to the pot with water enough to cover the chicken. Add the potatoes and your bay leaves and let cook for 20 minutes until your potatoes are fork tender. Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chipotlechicken #highprotein #mealprep #healthyrecipes

Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

For the Parmesan crusted eggs: Slice your jammy eggs in half. Add a pile of Parmesan cheese to a hot nonstick pan and place the eggs cut-side down directly onto the cheese. Let the Parmesan crisp and harden, then remove from the pan and top with the herby cottage cheese mixture. Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

VIRAL CARROT WRAPS 🥕 I’ve made a vacation of these with zucchini, pickles, jalapeños, and I had to put a spin on them with carrots. These are probably my second favorite after the zucchini, they come out really good, super pliable/ and they are a touch sweeter which went really well with the toppings I used here. A medium carrot has about 4 net carbs, so this is a great lower carb option if you’re watching carbs. Recipe makes 3-4 wraps Here is how I made it: 1.Preheat oven to 375F.  2.Shred 3 medium carrots into a bowl. Crack in an egg, add 1 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese, toss in 1/2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp chipotle pepper (optional), and a small pinch of salt. Mix really well. 3.Grab a cookie sheet, line with parchment paper (important!) and scoop the carrot mixture into circular shapes. You’ll get 3-4 good sized wraps here. 4.Pop it into the oven at 375F for 16-18 minutes. Then remove and let cool for a few minutes while you prep your fillings 5.I spread a base of my homemade guac here. Just mash 2 avocados with the juice of 1 lime, a large handful of freshly chopped cilantro, 1/2 small white onion, a couple pinches of salt, and about a tablespoon of toasted sesame seeds for crunch (optional).  6.I also added some leftover shredded beef (chicken or shrimp work just fine), topped with a tsp of sour cream, some sriracha, and more fresh cilantro. Again, use what you like here! 7.Plate them up and devour. If you make these, be sure to let me know on SHREDHAPPENS - these are a great lowcarb wrap or lower crab bread option, and a great way to sneak in some extra veggies. High-Protein Green Spaghetti + Chicken 🥘  Easy 5-day meal prep  Per Serving💪: ~535 calories | 54g protein | 49g carbs Ingredients⬇️ * 3 poblano peppers * 2 garlic cloves * ½ white onion * Cilantro, to taste * 8 oz Philadelphia 1/3 Less Fat Cream Cheese * 1 cup LACTAID 1% Lowfat Milk * 2 tbsp chicken bouillon * 8 oz Barilla Protein+ Spaghetti * 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast * 1 tbsp olive oil Chicken seasonings * Garlic salt * Onion powder * Black pepper * Italian herbs Instructions ⬇️ 1. Roast the poblanos  Air fry 3 poblano peppers at 400°F for 10 minutes. Place them in a bag and let them sweat. Once softened, peel off the skins and remove the seeds. 2. Cook the pasta  Cook 8 oz Barilla Protein+ Spaghetti according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 3. Make the green sauce Add the roasted poblanos, 2 garlic cloves, ½ white onion, 1 cup LACTAID 1% milk, 8 oz cream cheese, cilantro to taste, and 2 tbsp chicken bouillon to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. 4. Combine the sauce + pasta Heat a large pot over medium heat and pour in the green sauce. Once warmed through, add the cooked spaghetti and mix until evenly coated. 5. Prep the chicken  Slice 2 lb chicken breast into thinner pieces for even cooking. Season with garlic salt, onion powder, and black pepper. 6. Cook the chicken Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the chicken until fully cooked through (165°F internal temperature), then finish with Italian herbs. 7. Meal prep  Divide the green spaghetti and chicken evenly between 5 containers Save this for your next meal prep! 🤍 #fyp #mealprep #healthy #gymmotivation #inspo

🌌🍫 Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake 🍫🌌 Ingredients: For the chocolate cake: 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour 2 cups (400 g) granulated sugar ¾ cup (75 g) unsweetened cocoa powder 2 teaspoons baking powder 1½ teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk, room temperature ½ cup (120 ml) vegetable oil 2 large eggs, room temperature 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 cup (240 ml) hot coffee (or hot water) For the chocolate ganache filling: 1½ cups (270 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream 2 tablespoons butter For the galaxy mirror glaze: 1 tablespoon gelatin powder ¼ cup (60 ml) cold water 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar ⅔ cup (160 ml) sweetened condensed milk ½ cup (120 ml) water 1½ cups (270 g) white chocolate, chopped Gel food coloring (blue, purple, black, and pink) Edible glitter or luster dust (optional for stars ✨) Directions: Make the cake layers: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line three 8-inch round pans with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add buttermilk, oil, eggs, and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Gradually stir in hot coffee (batter will be thin). Divide evenly into pans and bake for 25–30 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely before assembling. Prepare the ganache filling: Heat heavy cream in a saucepan until just simmering. Pour over chocolate chips and butter in a bowl. Let sit for 3 minutes, then whisk until smooth and glossy. Allow to cool slightly before using. Assemble the cake: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread a layer of ganache. Repeat with the second and third layers. Smooth the outside with ganache for a clean surface. Refrigerate for 1 hour to set. Prepare the galaxy mirror glaze: Sprinkle gelatin over ¼ cup cold water and let bloom for 10 minutes. In a saucepan, combine sugar, sweetened condensed milk, and ½ cup water. Bring to a gentle boil, then remove from heat. Add bloomed gelatin and stir until fully dissolved. Pour over chopped white chocolate and let sit for 5 minutes. Blend with an immersion blender until smooth (avoid bubbles). Divide the glaze into separate bowls and tint with food colors (blue, purple, black, and pink). Let the glaze cool to about 90°F (32°C). Create the galaxy effect: Pour the colored glazes into one large bowl in swirls (don’t mix). Pour the glaze over the chilled cake from the center outward, letting the colors blend naturally. Divide the ground beef into 6 equal portions. 4. Season the beef lightly with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. 5. Place one tortilla on a hot skillet or griddle. 6. Press one portion of ground beef directly onto the tortilla, spreading it into a thin, even layer almost to the edges. 7. Cook beef-side down for 2–3 minutes until deeply browned and crispy. 8. Flip the tortilla and beef together, then immediately place a slice of cheddar cheese on top. 9. Cook for another 1–2 minutes until the tortilla is crisp and the cheese is melted. 10. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and beef. 11. Top each taco with shredded lettuce, diced onion, and diced tomatoes. 12. Drizzle generously with the creamy burger sauce. 13. Fold the tacos slightly and serve immediately while the beef is hot and the cheese is melted. 14. Add extra pickles or sauce if desired for an even more classic burger flavor. Algiers is the capital city of Algeria, the largest country in Africa, and is located on the Mediterranean coast. It is a bustling port city known for its mix of historical architecture, from French colonial buildings to Ottoman influences, particularly in the old town, known as the Casbah. As a major cultural and economic hub, Algiers is home to diverse cultural institutions, museums, and landmarks, reflecting Algeria's rich history and heritage. 📍The Bardo Museum The Bardo Museum is a prominent museum in Algiers housed in a former Ottoman palace. It features an extensive collection of prehistoric artifacts and exhibits that showcase Algeria's rich archaeological and anthropological heritage. The museum is especially known for its displays on ancient Amazigh culture, with a variety of fossils, tools, and relics that narrate the region’s history. 📍Jardin d'Essai Jardin d'Essai, or the Botanical Garden of Hamma, is a lush, sprawling garden in Algiers, created during the French colonial era. It is home to a wide variety of plant species from around the world, with beautiful walking paths, fountains, and ponds. The garden serves both as a peaceful retreat for locals and visitors and as an important center for botanical research in Algeria. 📍The Casbah The Casbah of Algiers is the historic heart of the city, a UNESCO World Heritage site filled with narrow, winding streets and whitewashed buildings. Its foundations date back to the 10th century during the Amazigh Zirid dynasty, although much of what stands today reflects Ottoman influence from the 16th century. It is known for its labyrinthine design, which played a key role during the Algerian War of Independence. The Casbah is also home to numerous historic mosques and palaces. 📍The Great Mosque of Algiers (Djamaa el Djazair) The Great Mosque of Algiers, known as Djamaa el Djazair, is a modern architectural marvel. It is the largest mosque in Africa and the third-largest mosque in the world. Located on the Mediterranean coast, the mosque boasts the tallest minaret in the world at 265 meters. It can accommodate up to 120,000 worshippers and includes a cultural center, a library, and a museum of Islamic art and history. Djamaa el Djazair is not only a place of worship but also a significant cultural and architectural landmark, symbolizing contemporary Islamic architecture in Algeria. #algeria #algerie #pourtoii #fyypp #paratii

STREET CORN PASTA 🌽 BIG BATCH Pasta, Episode 6 Per serving (makes 10) 655 Calories 54g Protein 77g Carbs 15g Fat I truly expected this recipe to be a total fail, but it ended up being one of my favorite pasta recipes I’ve ever made. The Ditalini perfectly matches the size of the corn kernels and the flavors integrate so well. Genuinely a 10/10  - STREET CORN 900g (32oz) frozen corn 180g (1.5 cups) Cotija 120g (1/2 cup) FAGE 0% Greek yogurt 75g (1/3 cup) light sour cream 6 cloves garlic, minced Handful of cilantro, chopped Juice & zest of 2 limes 1 Tbsp chili powder 1 Tbsp Tajín 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp onion powder CHICKEN 1150g (40oz) chicken breast, pounded thin 15g (1 Tbsp) oil Salt, black pepper, garlic powder & chili powder (add enough of each to coat chicken) PASTA 680g (24oz) ditalini 900g (32oz) chicken bone broth 354g (12oz can) fat free evaporated milk Garlic powder & salt, to taste FINISHING 180g (3/4 cup) FAGE 0% Greek yogurt 80g (2/3 cup) Cotija, finely grated Fresh cilantro, chopped Tajín, to taste Pinch of salt - 1.) Spread frozen corn on a sheet pan and broil 3-5 minutes until lightly charred. Mix with remaining street corn ingredients, cover & refrigerate. 2.) Coat chicken with oil, add seasonings, and add to the same sheet pan that you cooked the corn on. Bake at 375°F for about 30 minutes, then finely chop. 3.) Bring bone broth to a boil. Add ditalini and evaporated milk, reduce to medium-low and simmer ~20 minutes, stirring frequently, until pasta is cooked and thickened. It is more important to stir frequently in the final 10 minutes to prevent sticking 4.) Stir in chicken, Greek yogurt, Tajín & cilantro. Remove from heat, fold in street corn and Cotija, then rest a few minutes before serving. Divide into 10 servings, place in Macro Stacker containers for freezer storage, and enjoy! - This one is going in the Big Batch Cookbook 📚✍️ (coming early 2027!) #stealthhealth #mealprep #frozenmealprep #freezermealprep

Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes
